proofs.async-base-table: Exact NwAsyncSession mangled type/COL/table in both files; native 3663 construction writes this base table before the derived virtual-session table.

proofs.frame: Paired Send bodies convert AsyncRequestSend* to the queue item at +0x30; the independently matched queue push receives exactly that derived pointer, as on 2976.
proofs.server-recv: Direct-call-neighbour matching ranks 0x2A0EA70 first (six mapped callees); paired Ghidra bodies independently confirm six-argument receive ABI, framed-length check, server kind/channel dispatch and session handling.
